episodes.title: This is Stadium Builder
episodes.summary: An empty pitch and one rule: 1 club = 1 stand. Name your club in the comments to build its stand.

episodes.title: Day 2: your comments built 32 stands ⚽ Level 2 unlocked
episodes.summary: You named 32 real clubs in 38 comments. Real Madrid and Barcelona lead with 700 seats each. Total: 16,600 seats, Level 2 Town stadium. Which club gets stand #33?

episodes.title: Day 3: Barça pulls ahead ⚽ 17,100 seats
episodes.summary: Five new comments: Barcelona +300, Real Madrid +200. Total 17,100 seats, Level 2 Town stadium, 32 clubs. Canada vs Romania wait — which club builds stand #33?
